title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: The pre-game warm-up
hook: How long before first pitch do you start warming up?
intro: Some are ready. Some are still tying shoes.
statement: A warm-up is for bodies and nerves.
q1: Do you run a full warm-up with set drills —
q2: or keep it short and loose?
q3: How do your players look in the first five minutes?
t1: Every team is different. But games start better
t2: when kids walk on the field ready.
cta: Coaches — how long is your warm-up?
ctaLines: Ten minutes. Throwing partners. A few sprints.
ctaPrompt: Share your warm-up habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How long before first pitch do you start warming up?
Players arrive twenty minutes early. Some are ready. Some are still tying shoes.
A warm-up is for bodies and nerves.
A full warm-up or a short loose one. There is no perfect answer.
How long is your warm-up? Share your habit in the comments.
